name: LilyPond
description: Installs LilyPond from the official precompiled package on x86_64 glibc systems, builds from source on non-x86_64 glibc systems and on Alpine when the texlive feature is present, or falls back to the distro package manager otherwise.

version.description: LilyPond version to install (e.g. '2.26.0', '2.24.4'). Used for the official binary and source builds. Ignored when falling back to the distro package manager (Alpine without the texlive feature).

texliveFonts.description: When true, registers the fonts installed by the 'texlive' feature with fontconfig so LilyPond can use them for text rendering.
